row.evidence: Dialpad's pricing page lists 'SSO (Okta, Azure & OneLogin)' only under Enterprise (Contact us for pricing), and both Dialpad's OneLogin SCIM guide and JumpCloud's Dialpad guide list a 'Dialpad Enterprise plan' as a prerequisite.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated) but the SCIM plan moved from Pro to Enterprise: June's claim that SCIM is on Connect Pro ($25/u/mo) has no first-party source on 2026-10-05 and was dropped. The Connect pricing tab now shows Standard $15, Pro $25 (user/month, annual toggle; monthly $27/$35 in the page data) and Enterprise 'Contact us for pricing' with 'Provide secure access with SSO'; the feature data lists 'SSO (Okta, Azure & OneLogin)' only for Enterprise, and Enterprise has a 100-seat minimum. Dialpad's Okta SCIM article conflicts, saying the Okta SCIM integration 'is available for all Dialpad users'; other help articles defer to the pricing page. SCIM base URL https://dialpad.com/scim with a Dialpad API key; deprovisioning suspends the user and frees the licence; SCIM can set licence type (not with Entra). The REST user API (Open APIs & webhooks) appears from Pro, not Standard.

plans.name: Standard (Dialpad Connect)
plans.notes: Seat minimum 1. Page data gives $27 monthly. A generic 'Single sign-on' row appears on every plan in the feature data, but the Okta/Azure/OneLogin SSO row is Enterprise-only. SCIM marked false from the Enterprise prerequisite on the OneLogin and JumpCloud guides, contradicted by the Okta article.

plans.name: Pro (Dialpad Connect)
plans.notes: Seat minimum 3; $35 monthly in page data. 'Open APIs & webhooks' first listed here.

scim.notes: sso_required from JumpCloud's guide ('SCIM requires SAML 2.0 SSO to be configured'); Dialpad's own guides set up SAML first but do not state it as a hard requirement. Plan gate conflicts with the Okta article (see conflicts).

auth.token_source: Admin Settings > My Company (Company Settings) > Authentication > API Keys > Add key
auth.token_expiry: Set by the admin when the key is created

endpoints.notes: No public SCIM API reference; endpoints inferred only from IdP setup guides.

operations.notes: Updates are documented (Okta, JumpCloud) but the HTTP verbs are not. Deleting the user in the IdP suspends it in Dialpad. Entra guides mention users and/or groups and say group renames are not supported; JumpCloud says groups are not supported, so group push is left null.

deprovision.data_retained: User is suspended, hidden from the team list but still searchable with status Suspended.

custom.how: Custom attributes (officeName, licenseType) go in the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User namespace; licenseType values include dialpad_talk, dialpad_lite, dialpad_support, dialpad_sell, dialpad_tfb. Office is matched from officeName/physicalDeliveryOfficeName/department, falling back to country.

attributes.notes: Attribute names are from the Okta mapping table (First Name, Last Name, Username->Email, department/officeName->Office, countryCode, preferredLanguage, title, licenseType); exact SCIM paths are not published.

roles.notes: No role mapping documented; SCIM can set licence type (product), see limitations.

limitations.text: Phone numbers and extensions cannot be changed through Okta SCIM; use the Admin portal.
Entra SCIM does not support the licenseType attribute.
Group renames (displayName changes) from Entra are not applied.
JumpCloud: groups not supported; @jumpcloud.com must be added as a secondary domain by Dialpad support.
Provisioning beyond purchased licences adds licences billed at the prorated amount.

user_api.notes: Plan inferred from the pricing page feature data: 'Open APIs & webhooks' is listed for Pro and Enterprise, not Standard.

capabilities.notes: PATCH user 'state' suspends or re-activates; 'license' and 'is_super_admin' fields on update; access control policies act as custom roles.

endpoints.purpose: List company users, optional email filter
Update user (incl. state suspend/reactivate, license, admin)
Assign user to an access control policy

webhooks_user_events.notes: Delivered as Change Log event subscriptions (scope change_log).

audit_log_api.notes: Change Log event subscriptions stream admin changes but no queryable audit-log API is documented.

rate_limits.text: 20 requests/second per company; most endpoints 1200 per minute.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Attribute Sourcing, Deactivate and Attribute Writeback (page markup); Group Push not marked.

google.notes: From Dialpad's own guide (SAML catalog app with provisioning); Google's catalogue page not checked.

conflicts.text: Dialpad's Okta SCIM article says the Okta SCIM integration 'is available for all Dialpad users', while Dialpad's OneLogin marketplace page and JumpCloud's guide list a Dialpad Enterprise plan as a prerequisite and the pricing page lists Okta/Azure/OneLogin SSO only on Enterprise.

searched: help-centre search: scim, api key, single sign-on, saml
open_questions: Which Connect plan actually unlocks SCIM: Okta article says all users, OneLogin/JumpCloud guides say Enterprise; June's 'Pro' claim could not be sourced.
No public SCIM API reference: Groups, ServiceProviderConfig, filtering, pagination and PUT/PATCH support are undocumented.
Whether suspension via SCIM ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether the Google Workspace catalogue app is listed on Google's own page was not checked.
